newsitem.title: USA: Oncogene cancer compound Phase I started.
newsitem.headline: Oncogene cancer compound Phase I started.

text.p: Oncogene Science Inc said Tuesday that Pfizer Inc, its collaborative partner for the discovery and development of novel, small molecule anticancer drugs, has initiated Phase I clinical trials in the United States for CP-358,774 in cancer patients.
CP-358,774 is an orally active, small-molecule inhibitor of the epidermal growth factor receptor activity.

It is representative of a new class of anticancer drugs that target the underlying molecular mechanism involving oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes which play critical roles in the conversion of normal cells into a cancerous state.
Oncogene said that clinical development of CP-358,774 is being funded and managed by Pfizer under terms of a collaborative research and development agreement.
